title: Leocarpinolide B Attenuates Collagen Type II-Induced Arthritis by Inhibiting DNA Binding Activity of NF-kappaB.
authors: Linghu, Ke-Gang; Zhao, Guan-Ding; Zhang, Dai-Yan; Xiong, Shi-Hang; Wu, Guo-Ping; Shen, Li-Yu; Cui, Wen-Qing; Zhang, Tian; Hu, Yuan-Jia; Guo, Bing; Shen, Xiang-Chun; Yu, Hua
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物LB通过直接结合NF-kappaB p65抑制其DNA结合活性来缓解关节炎，涉及蛋白-DNA互作但非TF-DNA特异性建模，且方法以实验和分子对接为主，AI/物理模拟深度有限。
abstract: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is a chronic autoimmune disease triggered by a cascading inflammatory response. Sigesbeckia Herba (SH) has long been utilized as a traditional remedy to alleviate symptoms associated with rheumatism. Our previous study found that leocarpinolide B (LB), a sesquiterpene lactone isolated from the whole plant of SH, possesses potent a anti-inflammatory effect on macrophages. This study was designed to evaluate the therapeutic effects of LB on RA, and further investigate the underlying mechanisms. In collagen type II-induced arthritic mice, LB was demonstrated to decrease the production of autoimmune antibodies in serum and inflammatory cytokines in the joint muscles and recover the decreased regulatory T lymphocytes in spleen. Moreover, LB significantly suppressed the inflammatory infiltration, formation of pannus and bone erosion in the paw joints. In vitro testing showed that LB inhibited the proliferation, migration, invasion, and secretion of inflammatory cytokines in IL-1beta-induced human synovial SW982 cells. Network pharmacology and molecular docking suggested NF-kappaB p65 could be the potential target of LB on RA treatment, subsequent experimental investigation confirmed that LB directly interacted with NF-kappaB p65 and reduced the DNA binding activity of NF-kappaB in synovial cells. In conclusion, LB significantly attenuated the collagen type II-induced arthritis, which was at least involved in the inhibition of DNA binding activity of NF-kappaB through a direct binding to NF-kappaB p65. These findings suggest that LB could be a valuable lead compound for developing anti-RA drugs.
abstract_zh: 类风湿关节炎（RA）是一种由级联炎症反应触发的慢性自身免疫性疾病。豨莶草（SH）长期以来被用作缓解风湿相关症状的传统药物。我们先前的研究发现，从SH全草中分离出的倍半萜内酯类化合物豨莶草内酯B（LB）对巨噬细胞具有强效抗炎作用。本研究旨在评估LB对RA的治疗效果，并进一步探讨其潜在机制。在胶原蛋白II型诱导的关节炎小鼠中，LB被证明能降低血清中自身免疫抗体的产生及关节肌肉中炎症细胞因子的水平，并恢复脾脏中减少的调节性T淋巴细胞。此外，LB显著抑制了爪关节中的炎症浸润、血管翳形成及骨侵蚀。体外实验显示，LB抑制了IL-1β诱导的人滑膜SW982细胞的增殖、迁移、侵袭及炎症细胞因子的分泌。网络药理学和分子对接提示NF-κB p65可能是LB治疗RA的潜在靶点，随后的实验研究证实LB直接与NF-κB p65相互作用，并降低了滑膜细胞中NF-κB的DNA结合活性。总之，LB显著减轻了胶原蛋白II型诱导的关节炎，其机制至少涉及通过直接结合NF-κB p65抑制NF-κB的DNA结合活性。这些发现表明，LB可能成为开发抗RA药物的有价值的先导化合物。
